metadata.description: Curated agent skills encoding domain expertise, workflows, and high-quality execution patterns.

plugins.name: agency
plugins.description: All agency skills in one plugin, invoked as /agency:<skill>: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence, Rovo MCP setup), sales (estimates, quotations), docs (user guides and manual videos, agent instructions), dev (project initiation, React, UI/UX), DevOps (Coolify, OCI), token-saver, and context-management (per-project memory, credentials, and extensions installed as agency-skills-<ext_name> plugins).
